task: Implement the frontend for a new PR Interactions tab in the existing static GitHub Pages resource ledger. Parent owns Python validated-data export, generated interactions.html markup, build allowlist, Python tests and integration. You own only interactions.js, interactions.css and test_interactions.js. No installs, native runtime activation, external services, commits or further delegation. Read the complete UI/data contract in this assignment directory before writing. Use accessible semantic DOM and textContent/createElement rather than raw HTML injection; source text is untrusted. Do not infer message causality, complete history, actual execution models or per-PR token totals. Make responsive polished conversation bubbles distinguishing humans, agents and publishing accounts, searchable PR navigation, source selection and expandable evidence. Run meaningful JS controls and report actual checks, assumptions and files.
deliverable: Three owned frontend/test files implementing the supplied contract, plus concise integration instructions and actual checks. Parent verifies in a real browser.
completion: Parent can build the supplied HTML/data contract, navigate/search PRs, switch evidence sources, expand messages and inspect source/role/tool/account details without script injection or fabricated claims.
